result.title: How Deep is the Signal? Time-Context up to 30 Years for Colorectal Cancer Prediction in a Primary-Care EHR Model
result.comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026, Findings Track. 10 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
result.summary: EHR foundation models read medical events within a fixed context window, and long context has so far been measured only in tokens. How far back in time a model must look to capture the earliest predictive signal is unknown. We introduce time-context, the calendar lookback window before the prediction point, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic evaluation of decade-scale time-context for an EHR foundation model. We pretrained a decoder-only transformer (34.6M parameters) on 1.4B coded events from 3.6M primary-care patients in North West London and fine-tuned it to predict incident colorectal cancer under a 12-month pre-diagnostic buffer. A frozen cohort of 1,008 cases and 9,582 matched controls, all registered for at least 30 years, was evaluated at 15 nested lookback windows from 2 to 30 years, so that every truncation is compared within the same patients. Discrimination rose from an AUROC of 0.551 at 2 years to 0.590 at 18 years, then plateaued, with about 80% of the gain reached within 10 years; an XGBoost baseline converged to the same level (peak AUROC 0.589). A simulation further suggests that rotary position embeddings (RoPE) over elapsed time alias beyond about 20 years at the default base frequency, motivating a retuned $θ$. Time-context is a measurable design axis for clinical prediction models, distinct from token-context, and should be reported.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出以日历年回溯窗口定义的「time-context」设计轴，在340万基层医疗患者、14亿编码事件上预训练34.6M参数解码器transformer，并在固定队列（1008例/9582对照，注册满30年）上用2至30年的15个嵌套窗口评估结直肠癌预测，发现AUROC由2年0.551升至18年0.590后趋平。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「回溯窗口加长后收益递减」与「RoPE在默认基频下约20年后出现时间混叠、需重调θ」的观察，可能与LVR中视觉证据需回溯多远、位置编码与长度泛化的预测工作区问题相关，可供核查。
